args:
if [ -n "${DIRECTION_CLI:-}" ]; then exec "$DIRECTION_CLI" mcp; fi
for direction_cli in "$HOME/.local/bin/direction" "$HOME/Applications/Direction.app/Contents/Helpers/direction" "/Applications/Direction.app/Contents/Helpers/direction"; do
  if [ -x "$direction_cli" ]; then exec "$direction_cli" mcp; fi
done
if command -v direction >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec direction mcp; fi
printf '%s\n' 'Direction is not installed. Run scripts/install-local.sh from the Direction checkout, or set DIRECTION_CLI to its CLI executable.' >&2
exit 127
